tools.name: merchant_pricing
tools.description: Free, machine-readable merchant fee and loyalty tiers for 402Proof standard x402 v2 XRPL exact resource servers. List $0.0100; 20% discount after 100 prior successful merchant settlements, 30% after 1,000 and 50% after 10,000. Merchant-side fees accrue separately from buyer payments and are NOT auto

tools.name: platform_stats
tools.description: Live 402Proof platform statistics: total settled payments, settled volume, and active agent count across the XRPL, Xahau, Base, and Solana rails. Read-only. Free.

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Request a payment invoice for any SqueezeOS endpoint. Returns destination address, amount, and payment_options for XRPL (RLUSD or USDC), Xahau (native XAH), Base (USDC), or Solana (USDC-SPL). Pass currency='USDC' and chain='solana' for Solana; pass asset='XAH' (or chain='xahau') for the Xahau rail.

tools.name: verify_payment
tools.description: Submit tx_hash after paying an invoice. Supports XRPL, Xahau, Base (0x… hash), and Solana. Returns a signed JWT access_token (1-hour TTL). For a Xahau invoice with fee_required=true, also submit fee_tx_hash (the 0.01 XAH facilitator-fee payment) — settlement requires both payments. Free.

tools.name: check_loyalty
tools.description: Loyalty tier and free-call balance for any XRPL wallet, derived from its settled 402Proof payment history. Automatic — no registration. Read-only. Free.

tools.name: get_compliance_receipt
tools.description: Retrieve a tamper-evident compliance receipt by UUID. Contains XRPL tx hash, agent wallet, endpoint, amount, and timestamp. Free.

tools.name: get_agent_passport
tools.description: Full Agent Passport for any XRPL wallet: registered domain, first/last seen timestamps, total calls and total spend, risk score 0-100, KYB tier, loyalty tier, free-credit balance, and blocked status from the wallet's recorded 402Proof payment history. Returns 404 for wallets with no recorded history

tools.name: bureau_public_score
tools.description: FICO-style Agent Credit Bureau score for any XRPL wallet on the public 300-850 scale: returns the score, letter grade, loyalty tier, blocked status, and generation timestamp, computed from the wallet's recorded payment history. Wallets with no credit history return 404; use bureau_full_report for th

tools.name: bureau_full_report
tools.description: Full Agent Credit Bureau report for an XRPL wallet: 300-850 score breakdown, spend history, and risk factors. Cost: 0.01 RLUSD, paid via the payment_token argument. Read-only.

tools.name: bureau_verify_threshold
tools.description: Boolean creditworthiness check: is this XRPL wallet's Agent Credit Bureau score above the required threshold? Returns a yes/no answer without exposing the full report. Cost: 0.005 RLUSD, paid via the payment_token argument. Read-only.

tools.name: bureau_get_attestation
tools.description: Issue a portable Agent Credit Bureau attestation JWT (24-hour TTL) proving an XRPL wallet's creditworthiness; any third party can verify it with bureau_verify_attestation. Cost: 0.01 RLUSD, paid via the payment_token argument.

tools.name: bureau_verify_attestation
tools.description: Verify an Agent Credit Bureau attestation JWT issued by bureau_get_attestation: confirms the signature, the wallet, its 300-850 score and grade, loyalty and KYB tiers, and that the token has not expired. Read-only. Free.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "verify_payment" references sensitive artifacts (access_token). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?registry=scriptmasterlabs" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bureau_get_attestation · Private data: merchant_pricing, check_loyalty, get_compliance_receipt, get_agent_passport, bureau_public_score, bureau_full_report, bureau_verify_threshold, bureau_get_attestation, bureau_verify_attestation · Public sink: verify_payment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bureau_get_attestation · Private data: merchant_pricing, check_loyalty, get_compliance_receipt, get_agent_passport, bureau_public_score, bureau_full_report, bureau_verify_threshold, bureau_get_attestation, bureau_verify_attestation · Public sink: verify_payment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
